unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 "Add a Nano (XNO) settlement leg — a chain adapter your cheapest/fastest strategies always resolve to" on routexcc/routex. Argued in the target’s own cost-routing terms: Nano is feeless so the cheapest strategy settles at absolute zero with no oracle refresh, and sub-second finality makes it the fastest leg too; fitted to their adapter interface (@routexcc/chain-nano) and fee oracle; carried the live Vend nano-info endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev) to test a Nano leg against. https://github.com/routexcc/routex/issues/1
